articles.title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.41172v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop.
